method: Each scanned registrar PDF was opened in the Claude desktop app's built-in browser on Oct 23, 2026, rendered at 3x with pdf.js, and read with Tesseract.js OCR. The ballot question box and the 'Type of measure' and 'Percentage needed to pass' checkboxes on the county's Ballot Measure Submittal Form (page 1) were then compared visually with the page image. Obvious OCR character errors were corrected only after visual comparison; each correction is listed.
formNote: Page 1 is the jurisdiction's Ballot Measure Submittal Form. The form says: 'The information as it appears within the text box will be printed on the ballot and voter guide.' The measure letter is not on the form; it comes from the registrar's link for each file.
